module: Flowgraph node 'Get Foreach' (provider category). In a flowgraph created by a Foreach node, exposes the key and value of the current element, read from self.mgr.modules.foreach.
notes: C.tags is defined twice; the second definition overwrites the first.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Copies mgr.modules.foreach.key and .value to the output pins.
